variants.title: Классический акцент
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate one polished designer logo for a tasteful feminine womenswear boutique, age 24–38. Exact word: DONA in uppercase Latin letters, correctly spelled, on a single horizontal line. Place a separate realistic lipstick kiss imprint immediately AFTER the final A, functioning as expressive punctuation instead of a period. No literal dot. The O is an ordinary empty-counter letter: absolutely no kiss inside O or any letter. The kiss is prominent and legible, about 50–55% of the capital-letter height, not tiny. Clearly separate it from A with a harmonious gap of approximately one thin letter stem. All four letters and the kiss fully visible with generous margins. Deep ruby #66021F typography and lipstick. Kiss must resemble an actual pressed dry lipstick transfer: natural cupid bow, narrow lip separation, visible fine branching vertical creases, uneven pigment density, broken translucent pigment and small clear gaps. Not solid clipart, not glossy 3D lips, no face or teeth. Crisp refined typography, visually flat single-ink identity, no shadows, no mockup, no extra text. Genuinely transparent background. Typography: upright high-contrast couture Didone serif, balanced generous letter spacing. Kiss is gently tilted 12 degrees and placed like large punctuation in the lower half of the cap-height zone, bottom aligned to the word baseline.
